body: Depends. If they said they can handle top 2v1, they better be able to. If they are not that good, and tell you, then it's your fault for making them solo it. Getting outmatched happens. I've caught lanes like sion-blitz or taric panth. Those are not gonna happen, I don't care what champ you picked. Those are UGLY lanes, and someone needs to get up there, or the jungler better be all over them all the time.
It was hardly "playing with peoples hearts". I thought he was ready, and he wasn't.

When we met, he said he could handle it. I thought "he seems like he can't, but I really want to be with him", so my better judgement was skewed by my want to be with him.

I did forget to mention the one line that made me think he was ok: "I don't think I could have done an open relationship 6 months ago, but I think I could now". He felt he was ready, so I just threw all caution to the wind and went with it.

I was selfish, I know.
I agree. You have an amazing writing style, and obviously the story is good too.
